summary.text: Chris Tague is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly from District 102 who is running for New York State Senate District 51 in the November 3, 2026 general election as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Tague has represented Assembly District 102 since 2018, when he won a special election held April 24, 2018, over Aidan O'Connor Jr. (D) and Wesley Laraway (Reform).
He is not seeking re-election to the Assembly in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Agriculture, Election Law, Environmental Conservation, Real Property Taxation, and Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election for Senate District 51, Tague faces Michele Frazier (D / Working Families Party).
